from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,shlex,subprocess
from urllib.parse import urlsplit,unquote
task=Path("reports/T0009")
base=json.loads((task/"planning-baseline.json").read_text())
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()==base["head"]
for p,h in base["source_sha256"].items():
 actual=hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() if Path(p).is_file() else None
 assert actual==h,p
allowed={"docs/decisions.md","docs/handoffs/T0008-ground-derivations.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0009-proof-enumeration.md"}
changed=set()
for args in (["git","diff",base["head"],"--name-only","-z"],["git","ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard","-z"]):
 changed.update(p for p in subprocess.check_output(args).decode().split("\0") if p)
assert all(p in allowed or p.startswith("reports/T0009/") for p in changed),changed
docs=[Path(p) for p in sorted(allowed)]+[task/"planning-review.md"]
links=0
for p in docs:
 content=p.read_text()
 assert content.endswith("\n") and all(s==s.rstrip() for s in content.splitlines()),p
 for link in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)",content):
  parsed=urlsplit(link.strip().strip("<>"))
  if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc or not parsed.path:continue
  assert (p.parent/unquote(parsed.path)).exists(),(p,link)
  links+=1
handoff=Path("docs/handoffs/T0009-proof-enumeration.md").read_text()
assert "- 状态：`ready`" in handoff
inline=0
for line in handoff.splitlines():
 if line.startswith(".venv/bin/python "):
  tokens=shlex.split(line)
  assert "--" in tokens
  if "-c" in tokens:compile(tokens[tokens.index("-c")+1],"handoff-inline","exec");inline+=1
for p in task.glob("*.py"):
 compile(p.read_text(),str(p),"exec")
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],check=True)
subprocess.run(["git","check-ignore","-q","reports/T0009/pi-r1-full/pytest-tmp/example.txt"],check=True)
assert not Path("src/kmesh/logic/proof_enumeration.py").exists()
assert not Path("tests/test_proof_enumeration.py").exists()
summary={"result":"PASS","baseline":base["head"],"task_status":"ready","local_links":links,"inline_commands_compiled":inline,"sources_unchanged":True,"historical_tracked_paths_unchanged":True,"product_implemented":False}
(task/"planning-check/summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
